help_text: Create a revised figure from the complete spec returned by the previous call.

label: Find controls
description: Find controllable interface controls by meaning (query: semantic tools, figures, and every user-editable widget with panel and help text) or by canonical id prefix (widget kinds, allowed values, current values).
help_text: Find controllable interface controls by meaning (query: semantic tools, figures, and every user-editable widget with panel and help text) or by canonical id prefix (widget kinds, allowed values, current values).

label: Describe one control
description: Describe one control by exact id - a widget id gives kind, allowed values, dependencies, and current value; a semantic tool name gives the operating contract.
help_text: Describe one control by exact id - a widget id gives kind, allowed values, dependencies, and current value; a semantic tool name gives the operating contract.

label: Set widgets
description: Apply a JSON-object patch of canonical widget ids to values for controls the semantic tools do not cover.
help_text: Apply a JSON-object patch of canonical widget ids to values for controls the semantic tools do not cover.
